# Yogyakarta Temple Tours

- [Merapi Volcano Guide](https://www.yogyakarta-temple-tours.com/merapi): Indonesia's most active volcano

- [Yogyakarta Cooking Class vs Historical Food Tour](https://www.yogyakarta-temple-tours.com/yogyakarta-cooking-class-market-tour-vs-historical-food-tour): Morning market and tumpeng cooking class or a three-hour evening walk with dinner and a becak ride? A Jogja guide on which tour fits your day and appetite.

- [Yogyakarta Food Tour vs Cooking Class: Which to Book](https://www.yogyakarta-temple-tours.com/yogyakarta-historical-food-tour-vs-cooking-class): Choosing between Yogyakarta's evening historical food walk and a cooking class?
